title: Interview topic drills
description_md: Focused interview drills, one topic at a time: joins (inner, outer, self, anti, semi, range), window functions (ranking, NTILE, percentiles, aggregates and frames), value functions (LAG, LEAD, FIRST_VALUE, LAST_VALUE, NTH_VALUE), CTEs and recursive CTEs. Two to three problems per sub-topic, easy to hard, each with the classic trap planted and the follow-up an interviewer asks next.
